sources.note: Nothing. Ch. 3 Historische Phonologie treats Lohorung segmental correspondences only; all 26 'Akzent/Betonung' hits are non-technical uses or Appendix C on Hodgson's 1857/1880 diacritics; no tone statement. Sec. 1.1.4 (pp. 31-33) states no comprehensive description of Lohorung exists; van Driem 1992 offers 'eine Skizze der Phonologie' and his 193-page manuscript (van Driem o.D.) is unpublished.
